<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: ShipStatic Lockdown
 * Description: Keeps this WordPress site to its allowed addresses while ShipStatic's Lockdown is on. Generated by ShipStatic and removed when Lockdown is turned off.
 *
 * Does nothing unless ShipStatic is present and active, so renaming the
 * ShipStatic plugin folder is one way back in (see the gate file for others).
 */

defined('ABSPATH') || exit;

if (
    is_readable(WP_PLUGIN_DIR . '/' . __BS_BASENAME__)
    && (
        in_array(__BS_BASENAME__, (array) get_option('active_plugins', []), true)
        || (is_multisite() && array_key_exists(__BS_BASENAME__, (array) get_site_option('active_sitewide_plugins', [])))
    )
    && is_readable(__BS_GATE__)
) {
    require_once __BS_GATE__;
}
